summary: Reuse unchanged PTY registry metadata across reconciliation passes

rules.detail: Control actions continue to read fresh metadata and check daemon identity independently of the incremental snapshot.

compatibility.detail: No wire or client contract change.

recovery.detail: Snapshots reuse metadata by file identity, modification time and size, detect additions and replacements each pass, and avoid sidecar reads for exited sessions. Exit observations remain available without retaining output or environment payloads.
